name: two notes linking only to each other form an orphan component
why: Orphans are components with no root, not notes with no backlinks. x and y each have a backlink, yet nothing a reader can navigate to reaches them. The isolated note z is an orphan too.

queries.why: Sorted IDs are guide, home, x, y, z. The component holding guide is 0, then x's, then z's. Only component 0 holds the root home.
home -> guide is one-way, so they are separate strongly connected components; x and y reach each other.
The search starts at guide (no links), then home (to guide, already black), then x -> y -> x, where x is grey.
Changing x affects y, which cites it, and nothing else.
